title: RACI Matrix
prompt:
Act as an operations consultant specialising in team clarity.
Process or function  : [THE AREA YOU WANT TO MAP  e.g. client onboarding, 
                                        monthly reporting]
Team roles involved :
[LIST YOUR ROLES:  e.g. CEO, Sales Lead, Account Manager, Marketing Manager,
Operations Lead]
For each key task in this process, assign:
R  =  Responsible (does the actual work)
A  =  Accountable (one person - owns the outcome)
C  =  Consulted (gives input before action is taken)
I   =  Informed (told after action is complete)
Format as a clear table.
Flag any task with more than one A, explain the risk.
Flag any task with no clear R.
Recommend the 2 most urgent clarity fixes.
RACI Matrix Hierarchy
Accountable
Ultimately responsible for task completion
Responsible
Carries out the task
Consulted
Provided input and feedback
Informed
Kept up-to-date on progress
PRO TIP
If more than one person is marked Accountable for any task, the matrix is already
broken. There must be exactly one A per row that single constraint removes more
team friction than any team meeting ever will. When everyone knows who owns the
outcome, everything else becomes easier to delegate.
